# engine2040

> Rust game engine, deterministic and AI-native. One door (an MCP server) lets an AI set up, run and check a whole game. Proof game: a multiplayer Roman arena. Golden hash `d57b5c8ae3096614` (seed 2040, 600 ticks).

Read `docs/book/for-ai.md` first. It is short, and a test checks that every path and command in it exists.

## Start here

- [For AIs: read this first](docs/book/for-ai.md): what the engine is, the proofs to run, the rules that win, where plans live, the door verbs to start with
- [README](README.md): overview and the two proof commands
- [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup and gates
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): the doc map
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): crate layers and who may depend on whom
- [docs/CRATE-MAP.md](docs/CRATE-MAP.md): every crate with its job
- `node tools/modmap.mjs --pack <crate>`: one crate's packet (map slice, crate row, plan line, board rows), under 6,000 tokens

## Prove it works

- `cargo run --locked -- --verify` prints `final_hash=d57b5c8ae3096614` and `verified=true`
- `node tools/proof.mjs --skip-build` runs the seed and tape proofs
- `node tools/web-build.mjs` builds the browser shell into `dist/web` (`node tools/web-doctor.mjs` lists what is missing)
- `node tools/workspace-check.mjs` audits the workspace after board or doc edits

## Rules that win

- [docs/HASH-LAW.md](docs/HASH-LAW.md): what determinism proves; integers in simulation, no platform trig, the golden moves only with a receipt
- [docs/plan/web-and-realism.md](docs/plan/web-and-realism.md): the authority layer and the physical layer; one render writer at a time
- Commit by path: pull first, commit only your own paths, never `git add -A`, never rebase, amend or force-push
- [docs/RUST-QUALITY.md](docs/RUST-QUALITY.md): no stubs, `#[expect(reason)]` not `#[allow]`, `node tools/rust-quality.mjs` stays green

## Plans and rows

- [docs/FOCUS.md](docs/FOCUS.md): the order of work, section "Now"
- [docs/SPRINT.md](docs/SPRINT.md): the board. Slice it with `node tools/board-slice.mjs --focus`, `--ready` or a row id
- [docs/plan/README.md](docs/plan/README.md): one plan per subsystem; `node tools/plan-atlas.mjs --row <ID>` finds a row's plan
- [docs/SPRINT-22-web-realism.md](docs/SPRINT-22-web-realism.md): the browser, realism, AI setup and docs rows
- [tools/README.md](tools/README.md): the node tools
